title: How Does an AC Cool Your Room? ❄️
description: How does an air conditioner transform scorching outdoor air into a refreshing breeze? Discover the amazing scientific secret behind cooling in under a minute.

scenes.say: How does an air conditioner turn blazing hot air into a cool, refreshing breeze? The secret is all in the physics.

scenes.caption: Refrigerant Gas
scenes.say: The AC doesn't just create cold out of nowhere. It uses a special liquid called refrigerant to absorb heat from your room.
The gas flows through a pressure valve to get super cold, then a fan blows room air right across it.
The indoor unit absorbs the heat, while the outdoor unit dumps that exact heat outside your building.
Notice that water dripping from the AC pipe? That is not a leak. It is simply air moisture condensing as it cools down.
